newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras still a Caspian buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras still a Caspian buy.

text.p: Caspian Securities said it was maintaining its buy rating on Brazilian state-owned telecommunications firm Telebras based on continued strong fundamentals.
-- was also based on belief that recent currency devaluation fears are likely to prove unfounded.

-- Analysts Tony Figueiredo and Joanne Showalter said in a report that Telebras declined 10.3 percent since it hit its high of $165 on July 9 as investors took profits prompted by fears of a Brazilian currency devaluation following moves by some Asian countries.
-- "Due primarily to $90 billion in expected privatization revenues, we find these devaluation fears overblown," they said.
-- they also said the continue to prefer investors interested in Brazil focus on Telebras, although they also expect Telemig and Teleceara should also perform well over the next 12-18 months.
-- Teleceara is currently traded on Brazil's SOMA over-the-counter market. -- Telebras preferred was down 2.48 percent at 157 reais on the Sao Paulo bolsa earlier.
